Planner to Ziffr

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address, the Webhook's id and secret, and the id of the plan.
2. Add the Microsoft Graph "OAuth2 API" credential to the List tasks and Read notes nodes.
3. Activate the workflow. Every 5 minutes it tells Ziffr which tasks were completed or reopened, and passes on a line starting "Reply:" in a task's notes (its description).

Self-hosted n8n: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto. Details: docs/automations/planner.md
